description: 333 ranked Black Americans and Black places (306 people, 27 places, 23 categories), each Wikidata-verified on 2026-11-04 (322 with QIDs, 22 of them corrected on the record after first-hit errors) and each carrying a full AEO layer: primary question, direct answer, 5-question cluster, keywords, entity page slug, schema. 11 GAP rows have no Wikidata entity — subjects where CultureTechLens' record leads. Grown from 100 to 333 by documented snapshots and four addenda; the 333 AEO CSV is the canonical file (spec ruling 2026-11-16). Source registry for AEO-500's KG half.
